metadata.title: The Club
metadata.description: Liverpool FC — 20 league titles, 6 European Cups. Explore the history, stadium, legends, traditions and more.

hero.foundingStory: Liverpool FC was born from a bitter dispute. In 1892, Everton FC left Anfield over a rent disagreement with their landlord John Houlding. Left with a stadium but no team, Houlding founded Liverpool Football Club on 15 March 1892. The club was admitted to the Football League the following year and won their first league title in 1901. What began as one man's determination to fill an empty stadium has grown into one of the most successful and beloved football clubs in the world.
hero.tagline: Since 1892 — 20 league titles, 6 European Cups and one Anfield.

metadata.title: Legal
metadata.description: {brand}'s privacy policy, terms of use and data sources. An unofficial Liverpool fan site.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content: {brand} is an independent project and is not affiliated with Liverpool Football Club or Fenway Sports Group. We do not collect personal data beyond what is necessary for account functionality (email, username, avatar). Authentication is handled securely via Supabase. AI chat conversations are stored for continuity but are not shared externally. Gallery images are hosted on Cloudinary. We do not sell or share your data with third parties. The site shows Google AdSense ads; Google and its partners may use cookies to serve ads, and you can turn off personalised ads in your Google ad settings.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.content: This site is provided as-is for informational and entertainment purposes only. {brand} is an unofficial fan site and is not affiliated with Liverpool FC or the Premier League. All Liverpool FC trademarks, logos, and brand elements are the property of Liverpool Football Club and Athletic Grounds Limited. Match data is sourced from Football-Data.org and ESPN. Quick news shows only the headline, a short excerpt and a link to the original story; all rights in an article belong to the original publisher or author, and {brand} does not republish full articles. AI features (chat, translation, daily digest) are powered by VietAPI, with Groq for live web search. Use of this site constitutes acceptance of these terms.

sources.title: Data Sources
sources.content: League standings, fixtures and results are provided by Football-Data.org. Cup fixtures and match events are supplemented by ESPN. Player stats come from the Fantasy Premier League (public API); the squad and player profiles come from liverpoolfc.com. Quick news takes headlines and short excerpts from the publishers' public RSS feeds, with a link to the original story — English sources include LFC Official, BBC Sport, The Guardian, Liverpool Echo, Sky Sports, Anfield Watch, Empire of the Kop and GOAL; Vietnamese sources include VnExpress, Tuổi Trẻ, Thanh Niên, Dân Trí, ZNews, VietNamNet, Bóng Đá, 24h and Webthethao. AI chat, article translation and the daily digest are powered by VietAPI; the daily digest is drafted by AI and may contain mistakes. Live web search in chat uses Groq. Gallery images are hosted on Cloudinary. Historical data and trophy information are maintained by the site administrators based on publicly available records.
